title: Violence in Mallworld
content: Last night I was in a new place- the bowling alley and my whole school was there- it was crowded almost elbow to elbow. My friend and I were sitting at the ball return and it returned the severed heads of two goth kids with dyed hair and corpse paint. I locked eyes with their girlfriend and mouthed "sorry" as she burst into tears and my friend bagged the heads. Everyone was buzzing with excitement and upset at the discovery. Wtf happened before I got there? Who killed these teens?
